sc: Prolonged jaundice, constipation, big tongue, umbilical hernia, large fontanelle, high TSH → Congenital hypothyroidism: levothyroxine now
Short overweight girl, slow growth, goitre → Hashimoto thyroiditis
Teen girl, weight loss, tremor, goitre with bruit, exophthalmos, low TSH → Graves: carbimazole + propranolol
f: 1 : 2000–4000 · dysgenesis 85% · newborn screening TSH · prolonged jaundice, constipation, hypotonia, big tongue, hernia
Levothyroxine 10–15 µg/kg/day, start by 2 weeks (intellect depends on it) · follow TSH and T4
Hashimoto (girls, goitre) · slowing growth, delayed bone age, weight gain · check in Down syndrome
Graves: weight loss, tremor, goitre with bruit, eye signs · low TSH, TRAb + · carbimazole 0.25–1 mg/kg/day for 2–3 yr
Sore throat and fever → agranulocytosis: stop, CBC
Iodine deficiency (endemic cretinism) · Hashimoto · solitary nodule → ultrasound + FNA
trap: Do not wait for the result to start treatment when the clinical picture is clear · newborn of a Graves mother → neonatal thyrotoxicosis · absent knee epiphysis on X-ray = congenital hypothyroidism
